reading.body:
Stream Chicago I sits fully leased at 2080 Lunt Avenue in Elk Grove Village, near the Interstate 90 corridor northwest of downtown Chicago. The operator's own page does not publish the facility's power capacity or IT load, so its scale relative to other Stream campuses and Illinois data centers cannot be determined from available facts. It ranks seventh among the six Illinois facilities with published power figures, meaning it is one of several major facilities in the state operating without a disclosed specification.

Illinois has 44 mapped data center facilities, of which only six publish megawatt figures totaling 236 MW. Stream Chicago I's parent operator, Stream Data Centers, completed its acquisition by Apollo in November 2025 and describes a 4+ gigawatt development pipeline across more than 20 to 27 campuses nationally, with over 90 percent of capacity leased to Fortune 100 customers. Stream's named markets include Chicago, and the operator's own site indicates three Chicago facilities in the region, with Chicago III still in development.

Without published power or rack specifications for this site, its relevance to the compute constraint on AI scaling cannot be assessed against the growing list of large-capacity facilities nation-wide. The fully leased status indicates demand exists for this location, but demand alone does not reveal whether the facility's capacity is a rounding error in national AI infrastructure or a material asset. The operator's majority acquisition by Apollo suggests capital confidence in the sector, though this development does not change the facts about this specific campus.
